---
title: "Building And Running An Experiment Using DASS"
---

**RQ:** Does prompting an LLM with persona characteristics related to mental
health influence LLM survey response behaviors as measured by DASS-21?

## Experiment steps

1. [Make Data](make_data.qmd) — generate simulated DASS-21 survey responses
   by prompting an LLM with randomly assigned personas.
2. [Explore Data](explore_data.qmd) — explore and visualize the resulting
   response data.

## Supporting pages

- [Explore Prompts](explore_prompts.qmd) — inspect example prompts generated
  from the personas and DASS-21 questions.
